extra_quotes: Modes were computed with the finite-difference mode solver in Tidy3D 2.11.2 [24] on a 6.0×4.0µm domain at 32 grid steps per wavelength, with every layer boundary on a cell edge (Fig. S2).
Each geometry was solved at 11 frequencies spaced uniformly inωacross 1380 to 1720 nm, the 1400 to 1700 nm reporting band extended by 20 nm at each end.
A polynomial inωwas fitted ton eff (ω)and differentiated analytically to giveβ 2 = d2β/dω 2 andβ 3 = d3β/dω 3, with the order raised only while the fit residual continued to halve.
